project.name: Owen County
project.description: Owen County Schools Upgrades & Athletics - Domain flow graph showing 6 construction management domains and their relationships within the Devere/TCS Project Digital Twin framework.

nodes.name: Gate Readiness
nodes.summary: 11-gate matrix (A0-D2) controlling project advancement. 2 shell-ready, 9 blocked. No gate passes without human approval, cited evidence, and receipt. Gates span project identity, source chain, contract, Sage/commercial, schedule, procurement, submittals/RFIs, safety/quality, field execution, PM cadence, and owner view.

nodes.name: Digital Twin State
nodes.summary: Level 1 Twin Shell with identity, source map, gates, and stop rules present. 9-item validation queue tracking disputed/unverified seeds across submittals, RFIs, checklists, change management, safety, DPO, schedule, PM transition, and cleanpoints. 8 twin object families registered. Operating in review-only posture.

nodes.name: Doctrine & Operating System
nodes.summary: Altitude Mesh six-layer stack (subatomic/micro/meso/macro/VP/founder) governing all signal flow. PASP gates every upward wake. Three event classes (work/state/ratification). Cadence from continuous receipts to weekly manifests. Keystone Law: hard edges, soft interior.

nodes.name: Source Chain
nodes.summary: 6-rank authority hierarchy from executed contract to chats/OCR. 17 original OneDrive folders registered. 7 signal sources triangulated in master spine (Sage CM, OneDrive, Submittal Exchange, Tim CPR/DPO/Commitment lists, emails). 8 system-of-record candidates with disputed states. 6 missing evidence items.

nodes.name: Field Operations
nodes.summary: Active construction at 1945 KY-22, Owenton, KY 40359. HVAC subcontractor (Sunderland) communication challenges. 48 CPR entries tracked. OAC meetings with PM, superintendent, owner, and architect. Contract end 10/5/2026. Field coordination ongoing for baseball building, dugouts, and turf.

nodes.name: Evidence & Compliance
nodes.summary: 5 currentness work orders staged: CWO-001 Contract/Gate (P0), CWO-002 Sage/Commercial (P0), CWO-003 RFI/Submittal (P0), CWO-004 Schedule/3WLA (P1), CWO-005 Safety/QC (P0). Receipt-based validation with 7 fact states. Stop rules enforced: no Sage edits, no email, no file movement, no gate passes without approval.
